entries.source: Your party has completed # of 11 quests.
entries.text: 你的隊伍已完成 11 項任務中的 # 項。
entries.reason: 校正已完成數與總數的語序；保留 # 進度標記與總數 11。

entries.source: Balthazar has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the forge in the Temple of War to claim your reward.
entries.text: 巴薩澤已認可你的豐功偉業。返回 Temple of War 的熔爐領取獎勵。
entries.reason: Return 是返回領獎地點，並非暗殺者的影返；Temple of War 無固定中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Relive the events of the Canthan plague.
entries.text: 重溫凱珊瘟疫的經過。
entries.reason: Relive 指重歷該段事件；凱珊用字與既有中文 Wiki 地域用詞一致。

entries.source: Your party has completed [0...10] of 10 quests.
entries.text: 你的隊伍已完成 10 項任務中的 [0...10] 項。
entries.reason: 區分目前完成數與總數；完整保留 [0...10] 進度範圍。

entries.source: Grenth has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the Hall of Judgement to claim your reward.
entries.text: 古蘭斯已認可你的豐功偉業。返回 Hall of Judgement 領取獎勵。
entries.reason: 移除 Return 的影返誤譯；Hall of Judgement 無固定中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Go to North Kryta Province and follow the road to the fort in the D'Alessio Seaboard. Once there, report your presence to Mantle Knight Karriya.
entries.text: 前往科瑞塔北部，沿路抵達達雷西海濱的堡壘。到達後向 Mantle Knight Karriya 報到。
entries.reason: Report your presence 是報到，並非報告自己的存在；無中文身份證據的 NPC 保留英文。

entries.source: Exit Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head west to D'Alessio Seaboard. Enter the outpost and talk with Mantle Knight Karriya to complete the quest. It's a short trip; however, a few Fire Imps may cause trouble for low level characters. Bring sufficient healing.
entries.text: 從獅子拱門離開，進入科瑞塔北部，再向西前往達雷西海濱。進入據點後與 Mantle Knight Karriya 交談，即可完成任務。路程很短，但幾隻火焰小惡魔可能對低等級角色造成威脅；請帶足治療手段。
entries.reason: 校正徒步路線，移除駛入用語；Fire Imp 依中文詞典譯為火焰小惡魔，healing 指隊伍治療能力。

entries.source: Speak to First Spear Dehvad to gain entrance to the Training Area.
entries.text: 與 First Spear Dehvad 交談，以進入訓練區。
entries.reason: First Spear 是 NPC 稱號的一部分，並非第一名矛；缺中文身份證據，保留全名。

entries.source: Report to Castellan Puuba in the Sunspear Great Hall for further orders.
entries.text: 到日戟大會堂向 Castellan Puuba 報到，聽取進一步指示。
entries.reason: Orders 在軍事任務語境指指示，並非訂單；保留無中文身份證據的 NPC 全名。

entries.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail.
entries.text: 擊敗摩洛神秘通道中的受感染者（Afflicted）。
entries.reason: Afflicted 是瘟疫感染者，並非泛指受影響者；沿用先前任務審讀的受感染者與英文對照。

entries.source: See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.
entries.text: 向 Initiate Zei Ri 領取獎勵。
entries.reason: See 在獎勵目標中指與 NPC 交談領獎，並非請參閱；保留稱號和姓名。

entries.source: Leave from Durheim Archives and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. Try to only engage one group at a time.
entries.text: 從杜漢姆卷藏室出發，向西北偏西前進。途中擊敗幾群敵人後，會抵達一處布滿受感染者的圓形空地。共有 8 群敵人，每群都有一名代表《盟與敵》其中一個職業的 Boss。順時針或逆時針繞場推進，盡量一次只與一群交戰。
entries.reason: Factions 指篇章《盟與敵》，boss 指敵方頭目；保留 8 群、職業分組與逐群交戰的限制。

entries.source: Meet up with your profession trainer outside the city gate. Complete their test.
entries.text: 在城門外與你的職業導師會合，完成導師的測試。
entries.reason: Trainer 指職業導師；保留城門外的位置及必須完成測試的要求。

entries.source: Meet up with Devona and complete her task.
entries.text: 與德佛娜會合，完成她交付的任務。
entries.reason: Devona 與固定中文詞典一致；meet up 指會合，未改變任務對象。

entries.source: Choose a secondary profession. Visit trainers to try out different skills from each profession. Once decided, return to Armin Saberlin.
entries.text: 選擇副職業。拜訪各職業導師，試用不同職業的技能。決定後，返回阿明 沙貝林處。
entries.reason: 統一副職業與職業導師用詞；Armin Saberlin 依固定中文詞典保留姓名。

entries.source: Speak with Sir Tydus when you are ready to proceed.
entries.text: 準備好繼續後，與泰德閣下交談。
entries.reason: Speak with 指遊戲內交談，並非一般聯絡；Sir Tydus 的中文身份有詞典支持。

entries.source: Speak with any Town Crier to receive your reward.
entries.text: 與任一名城鎮傳令交談，領取獎勵。
entries.reason: Any 表示任一名 NPC 均可；保留領獎而非指定唯一對象的條件。

entries.source: Step out of the gates of Ascalon City into the idyllic meadows of Lakeside County. Your first task is to master the fundamentals of your chosen Primary Profession. Depending on your chosen profession, the available quest will vary:
entries.text: 走出阿斯卡隆城的大門，進入湖畔郡風景如畫的草地。首要任務是掌握所選主職業的基礎。可接取的任務會隨主職業而異：
entries.reason: Primary Profession 是主職業；明確任務可用性取決於主職業，保留引出下列清單的語意。

entries.source: Accept your respective quest and complete it. Once you have proven your basic competence, travel southwest along the road to the village of Ashford to meet with Devona. She will task you with investigating some Unsettling Rumors.
entries.text: 接取並完成對應職業的任務。證明已掌握基本能力後，沿路向西南前往 Ashford 村，與德佛娜會合。她會交付「不安的傳聞」，讓你調查那些傳聞。
entries.reason: Respective 指各主職業對應任務；保留西南方向，任務名依詞典，Ashford 缺中文專名證據。

entries.source: After you finish that quest, you must expand your horizons by selecting a secondary profession. Caution: Your choice of a secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game; therefore, it is advised not to lock in your choice until you are done with adventuring in this area.
entries.text: 完成該任務後，接著選擇副職業。注意：副職業要到遊戲較後期才能更換，因此建議完成此區域的冒險後，再確定副職業。
entries.reason: 保留暫時無法更換副職業的警告；not until done 指完成本區冒險之後再確定。

entries.source: The following quests unlock a secondary profession:
entries.text: 以下任務可解鎖副職業：
entries.reason: 統一 secondary profession 為副職業；保留後接任務清單的功能。

entries.source: Elementalist The Elementalist Experiment
entries.text: 元素使：元素使的實驗
entries.reason: 原文為職業與任務名兩欄；補上分隔，避免重複詞被讀成同一名稱。

entries.source: After you have firmly locked in your secondary profession, return to Ascalon City and speak to Armin Saberlin. Accept the quest A Second Profession from him (if you haven't already done so) and accept the reward from that quest to proceed. Then speak to a Town Crier for your reward.
entries.text: 確定副職業後，返回阿斯卡隆城與阿明 沙貝林交談。若尚未接取「副職業修練」，先向他接取，並領取該任務的獎勵以繼續。然後與城鎮傳令交談，領取本任務的獎勵。
entries.reason: 區分前置任務與目前任務的兩次領獎；保留未接取時須先接取的條件。

entries.source: Help the Dwarves locate and flee through the Asuran Gate.
entries.text: 幫助矮人找到阿蘇拉傳送門，並穿過傳送門逃離。
entries.reason: Flee through 指穿過門逃離，並非逃離阿蘇拉之門本身。

entries.source: Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.
entries.text: 與巴德克小徑中的涵洛教友交談。
entries.reason: 核對地點、NPC 與交談目標一致；兩個專名均有固定中文詞典支持。

entries.source: Travel with Brother Mhenlo to find his old teacher, Master Togo.
entries.text: 與涵洛教友同行，尋找他昔日的老師藤吾大師。
entries.reason: Travel with 是同行；old teacher 指昔日的老師，並非限定老師年老。

entries.source: See Guardsman Chow for your reward.
entries.text: 向 Guardsman Chow 領取獎勵。
entries.reason: 移除將 Chow 當成星期的週字誤譯；無中文身份證據，保留完整 NPC 名稱。

entries.source: After leaving Kaineng Center, speak with Mhenlo right outside. Then follow the marker to Emi and Chiyo in a large courtyard area. After Mhenlo and the twins talk for a moment, the quest will update and you, Mhenlo, and his gang will travel to the Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) entrance, where Guardsman Chow will let you enter Vizunah Square.
entries.text: 離開凱寧中心後，先與就在門外的涵洛交談。接著沿任務標記，前往一處大庭院尋找 Emi 和 Chiyo。涵洛與雙胞胎交談片刻後，任務會更新；你、涵洛及其同伴將前往薇茹廣場(外地區域)入口，Guardsman Chow 會讓你進入薇茹廣場。
entries.reason: Gang 在此指同行同伴，並非幫派；沿用有中文證據的入口名，移除三個無證據 NPC 的音譯。

entries.source: Seek assistance from the Asura. (The Knowledgeable Asura)
entries.text: 向阿蘇拉尋求協助。（The Knowledgeable Asura）
entries.reason: 保留阿蘇拉協助目標；括號內是任務名，缺固定中文身份證據時保留英文。

entries.source: Gain the Norn as allies. (Northern Allies)
entries.text: 與諾恩結盟。（Northern Allies）
entries.reason: Allies 指取得盟友，並非同盟國；括號中的任務名無固定中文證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands. (The Missing Vanguard)
entries.text: 前往夏爾故土，尋找黑檀先鋒隊（Ebon Vanguard）。（失蹤的先鋒隊）
entries.reason: 補全被截短成黑檀的組織身份；先鋒隊用詞由 Ebon Vanguard rank 中文詞典佐證，任務名依固定詞典。

entries.source: Look into the scrying pool at the Eye of the North.
entries.text: 查看極地之眼的 Scrying Pool。
entries.reason: Look into 指查看占卜裝置；Scrying Pool 缺固定中文專名證據，保留英文以便對照。

entries.source: Seek out Jalis Ironhammer and help summon the power of the Great Dwarf. (Heart of the Shiverpeaks)
entries.text: 尋找亞理斯 艾倫海默（Jalis Ironhammer），協助召喚偉大矮人的力量。（席娃山脈之心）
entries.reason: Jalis 身份對照詞典 King Jalis Ironhammer；保留協助召喚而非親自取代召喚者的語意。

entries.source: Eliminate the Destroyers. (A Time for Heroes)
entries.text: 消滅 Destroyers。（英雄的光彩年代）
entries.reason: 保留無固定中文專名證據的 Destroyers；括號中的任務名有固定中文詞典支持。

entries.source: Leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside. Follow the quest marker north and into the Eye of the North. Once there, you will be directed into the Hall of Monuments. Speak with Gwen and look into the Scrying Pool. Choose to keep your eyes open to receive The First Vision and three primary quests:
entries.text: 離開 Boreal Station，與外面的喬拉交談。沿任務標記向北前往極地之眼，再依指引進入史蹟殿堂。與關交談並查看 Scrying Pool。選擇繼續睜眼觀看，以接取 The First Vision 與三項主要任務：
entries.reason: 修正 keep your eyes open 被寫成睜大眼睛；保留向北路線、觀看選擇與三項主要任務，無中文證據的名稱保留英文。

entries.source: These three quests can be done in any order. When all three are completed, look into the Scrying Pool once more. Select "Look Deep into the Pool" to activate The Final Vision.
entries.text: 這三項任務可依任意順序完成。全部完成後，再次查看 Scrying Pool，選擇「Look Deep into the Pool」以觸發 The Final Vision。
entries.reason: 保留任意順序及必須全數完成的門檻；選項原文便於與遊戲比對，避免自創中文選項名。

entries.source: Your next task is to travel to Jalis Ironhammer, receiving the quest Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
entries.text: 接著前往亞理斯 艾倫海默（Jalis Ironhammer）處，接取「席娃山脈之心」。
entries.reason: 校正前往人物所在地的語序；人物身份對照 King Jalis Ironhammer，任務名依固定中文詞典。

entries.source: Upon completion, Jalis will give you the quest Destruction's Depths. While this is not part of the quest objectives, it is needed to reach the Central Transfer Chamber where the final task awaits.
entries.text: 完成後，Jalis 會交付「破壞的深淵」。雖然它不列在本任務的目標中，仍須完成它，才能抵達 Central Transfer Chamber，進行最後的任務。
entries.reason: 保留未列入目標但仍是必經步驟的區別；Central Transfer Chamber 缺固定中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Once inside the Central Transfer Chamber, talk to High Priest Alkar to receive the final quest, A Time for Heroes. Finishing it marks the end of Eye of the North's storyline and sends you to the Epilogue, where you can receive the quest reward and a Droknar's Key from Droknar.
entries.text: 進入 Central Transfer Chamber 後，與高等祭司 阿爾卡交談，接取最後的任務「英雄的光彩年代」。完成後，《極地之眼》的劇情即告結束，你會被送往 Epilogue；在那裡向 Droknar 領取任務獎勵與一把 Droknar's Key。
entries.reason: 保留最終任務、傳送至尾聲與領獎者的先後關係；不自創地點、人物及鑰匙名稱。

entries.source: Start the Tutorial by speaking to Kormir. She will explain how to walk and how to interact with other characters. Go to the chest behind you, open it, and pick up the weapon. then go into your Inventory and equip it (either by double-clicking it, or dragging it to your weapon slot). Speak to Kormir once again to continue. She will then explain Quests and how to use the Compass. Follow her toward the gate, where she explains how Loot Drops work.
entries.text: 與 Kormir 交談，開始教學。她會說明如何移動，以及如何與其他角色互動。打開身後的寶箱，拾取武器，再開啟物品欄裝備武器；可雙擊武器，或將它拖到武器欄位。再次與 Kormir 交談以繼續。她會介紹任務與指南針的用法。跟著她走向大門，聽她說明戰利品掉落機制。
entries.reason: 修正 Loot Drops 的中英碎詞；保留拾取後仍須裝備、雙擊或拖曳兩種操作與再次交談的次序。

entries.source: Proceed to the next two groups of corsairs and kill them. While running, listen as Kormir explains the Aggro Range Circle on your compass. Speak to Kormir again to get your reward. She will explain what Attribute Points and Skill Points are. Speak to her again to get your next primary quest.
entries.text: 前往並擊敗接下來兩群海盜。行進時，聽 Kormir 說明指南針上的警戒範圍圓圈。再次與她交談，領取獎勵；她會介紹屬性點數與技能點數。再交談一次，接取下一項主要任務。
entries.reason: Aggro Range Circle 是引起敵人警戒的範圍，並非武器攻擊距離；保留兩次交談的不同用途。

entries.source: See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.
entries.text: 向 First Spear Jahdugar 領取獎勵。
entries.reason: First Spear 是 NPC 稱號，並非第一個矛；完整保留無中文身份證據的名稱。

entries.source: Walk to First Spear Jahdugar and speak with him. Choose to enter. That's it.
entries.text: 前往 First Spear Jahdugar 處與他交談，選擇進入，即可完成。
entries.reason: 保留交談後仍須選擇進入的操作；移除 First 矛的混合誤譯。

entries.source: Defeat [18..0] more mantid hatchlings.
entries.text: 還需擊敗 [18..0] 隻螳螂幼體。
entries.reason: More 在倒數目標中表示剩餘數量；完整保留 [18..0] 進度標記。

entries.source: Follow Instructor Ng and speak to him each time he requests. Kill all the mantids on the way. After you are resurrected at the resurrection shrine, you receive two skills.
entries.text: 跟隨 Instructor Ng，每當他要求時就與他交談。擊殺沿途所有螳螂。在復活神殿復活後，你會獲得兩項技能。
entries.reason: 保留依要求逐次交談、沿途清敵及復活後才獲技能的順序；NPC 無中文身份證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Go to the town square in Ascalon City. Talk to Sir Tydus.
entries.text: 前往阿斯卡隆城的城鎮廣場，與泰德閣下交談。
entries.reason: 核對地點與 NPC 對象一致；合併兩個連續步驟，未增加條件。

entries.source: Head north from the Town Crier, crossing the stone bridge. You will find Sir Tydus on a podium just in front of the gate to the Ascalon Academy. Speak to him to claim your reward and learn of his news.
entries.text: 從城鎮傳令處向北，越過石橋。泰德閣下站在阿斯卡隆學院大門前的臺子上；與他交談，領取獎勵並聽取消息。
entries.reason: 保留向北、過橋與門前臺子的定位資訊；移除行駛與瞭解他的訊息等生硬語句。

entries.source: Speak to Vekk in the Hall of Monuments.
entries.text: 在史蹟殿堂與 Vekk 交談。
entries.reason: 核對 Hall of Monuments 地點與交談對象；Vekk 無固定中文身份證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations.
entries.text: 穿過弗洛森古蹟中的阿蘇拉傳送門。
entries.reason: Journey through 指通過傳送門，並非單純穿越古蹟；統一傳送門用詞。

entries.source: Assemble a krewe for project G.O.L.E.M.
entries.text: 為 G.O.L.E.M. 計畫組成研究團隊。
entries.reason: Krewe 是阿蘇拉的研究團隊，並非組裝名為克魯的物件；保留計畫縮寫。

entries.source: Recruit Gadd to help with the project. (Finding the Bloodstone)
entries.text: 招募 Gadd 協助計畫。（尋找血石）
entries.reason: 保留招募對象及對應任務；Gadd 單獨姓名缺固定中文詞條，不採用先前不一致的音譯。

entries.source: Enlist Oola to help with the project. (The Elusive Golemancer)
entries.text: 邀請 Oola 協助計畫。（烏拉的實驗室）
entries.reason: Enlist 指招攬協助；任務中文名依固定詞典，人物姓名保留英文。

entries.source: Acquire Renk's help with the project.
entries.text: 取得 Renk 對這項計畫的協助。
entries.reason: Acquire help 指取得協助而非獲得人物；移除無固定中文身份證據的音譯。

entries.source: Protect the golem foundry from the Destroyers. (Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation)
entries.text: 保護魔像鑄造廠，使其免受 Destroyers 攻擊。（Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation）
entries.reason: 保留防守目標及對應任務身份；不把完整任務名逐字誤譯成生活附魔表現。

entries.source: If starting from Olafstead, journey south-west through Varajar Fells to Verdant Cascades. Continue traveling west to Umbral Grotto.
entries.text: 若從歐拉夫之地出發，向西南穿過維拉戛陣地，前往 Verdant Cascades，再繼續向西抵達陰影石穴。
entries.reason: Olafstead 依固定詞典修正為歐拉夫之地；完整保留西南後向西的路線。

entries.source: For new characters starting from the Eye of the North, you can travel west into Battledepths then follow the northern route to reach Varajar Fells. The mini map will display where the exit is.
entries.text: 新角色若從極地之眼出發，可先向西進入戰鬥深淵，再沿北側路線抵達維拉戛陣地。小地圖會顯示出口位置。
entries.reason: 保留適用起點、向西與北側路線兩段方向；未改成全程向北。

entries.source: From Umbral Grotto, travel through the dungeon Vloxen Excavations to the south western exit on level 1. Be wary of rolling boulders, they will instantly kill anything in their path.
entries.text: 從陰影石穴進入弗洛森古蹟地城，前往第 1 層的西南出口。小心滾動的巨石；路徑上的任何單位都會被瞬間擊殺。
entries.reason: 保留樓層、出口方向與巨石立即致死的警告；不是一般逐步傷害。

entries.source: After the cinematic, adventurers will find themselves in Vlox's Falls. From here on, the story branches into three separate quest chains.
entries.text: 過場動畫結束後，隊伍會來到 Vlox's Falls。從此處開始，劇情分成三條獨立任務鏈。
entries.reason: Cinematic 指過場動畫，並非電影；地點無固定中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Take the quest Finding Gadd from Livia. Upon completion, you are offered the quest Finding the Bloodstone. Finish it to recruit Gadd.
entries.text: 向莉薇亞接取「尋找蓋德」。完成後會接到「尋找血石」，再完成後即可招募 Gadd。
entries.reason: 保留連續兩項任務的先後與招募條件；兩個任務名均依固定中文詞典。

entries.source: Take the quest Lab Space from Lork. It will lead you to Rata Sum. On your way there, consider making a little detour to advance Renk's quest chain (see below) or to unlock Tarnished Haven. Either way, completing Lab Space will directly lead to The Elusive Golemancer, gaining the support from Oola.
entries.text: 向 Lork 接取「工廠空間」，任務會帶你前往洛達頂點。途中可考慮稍作繞路，推進 Renk 的任務鏈（見下文），或解鎖灰暗避難所。無論是否繞路，完成「工廠空間」後都會直接接到「烏拉的實驗室」，進而取得 Oola 的支持。
entries.reason: Detour 是可選路線；Either way 表示兩種安排皆可，不能誤作必須完成支線；任務名依固定詞典。

entries.source: Take the quest A Little Help from Plaxx. As mentioned above, the first objective can be completed on your way to Rata Sum. The remaining objectives can only be completed after recruiting the other two Asura, making Renk the final addition to your krewe.
entries.text: 向 Plaxx 接取 A Little Help。如上所述，第一項目標可在前往洛達頂點的途中完成。其餘目標則必須等另外兩名阿蘇拉加入後才能完成，因此 Renk 會是最後加入研究團隊的成員。
entries.reason: 保留其餘目標受招募進度限制，以及 Renk 最後加入的因果；A Little Help 無中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: When turning in the last quest at Mamp, pick the follow-up quest, Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, and complete it.
entries.text: 向 Mamp 回報最後一項任務時，接取後續任務 Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation，並完成它。
entries.reason: 保留回報、接取後續與完成三步；修正無中文證據任務名的逐字錯譯。

entries.source: Talk to Mamp again to finish the asuran storyline and claim your reward.
entries.text: 再次與 Mamp 交談，完成阿蘇拉劇情並領取獎勵。
entries.reason: 保留再次交談這個收尾步驟；統一阿蘇拉用詞，不使用無身份證據的 NPC 音譯。

entries.source: Head southeast to the Shards of Orr. Use the Asura Gate inside the entrance to gain access to Gadd's Encampment. Rendezvous there with Bartholos.
entries.text: 向東南前往歐爾殘跡。使用入口內的阿蘇拉傳送門，進入蓋德營區，並在那裡與 Bartholos 會合。
entries.reason: 保留入口內傳送門通往另一據點的關係；Bartholos 無固定中文身份證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Join Livia and Gadd in Sparkfly Swamp.
entries.text: 在火星蠅沼澤與莉薇亞和 Gadd 會合。
entries.reason: Join 是與同伴會合，並非加入區域；保留兩名同行者，Gadd 不採無證據音譯。

entries.source: Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.
entries.text: 協助莉薇亞從 inscribed ettins 身上收集銘文。已收集 3 份銘文中的 [0...3] 份。
entries.reason: 校正完成數與總數語序，保留 [0...3] 進度標記；敵人種類無固定中文專名證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Return to the entrance of the Bloodstone Caves.
entries.text: 返回血石洞入口。
entries.reason: Return 在此是返回入口，並非影返技能。

entries.source: Activate the inscription and gain entrance to the Bloodstone Caves.
entries.text: 啟動銘文，進入血石洞。
entries.reason: 核對啟動銘文是取得入口權限的步驟；Bloodstone Caves 有固定中文名稱支持。

entries.source: This is a fairly long quest and you should have around fifty minutes devoted to do it. To get to the Shards of Orr dungeon, start at Vlox's Falls and head southeast. The Krait along the way should be relatively easy.
entries.text: 這項任務相當長，應預留約五十分鐘。從 Vlox's Falls 向東南前進，即可抵達歐爾殘跡地城；沿途的環蛇應不難對付。
entries.reason: Around fifty minutes 是建議預留時間，並非強制限時；保留東南方向及環蛇的敵人身份。

entries.source: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
entries.text: 與 Ludo 交談，以進入寺院。
entries.reason: 保留交談後取得入口權限的條件；Ludo 無固定中文身份證據，保留英文。

entries.source: Seek out Headmaster Zhan in the monastery.
entries.text: 在寺院內尋找 Headmaster Zhan。
entries.reason: 保留寺院內的位置；完整 NPC 姓名與稱號缺中文身份證據，不混用詹掌教與詹校長。

entries.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills once you load into the Monastery.
entries.text: 與星岬寺入口處的 Ludo 交談，即可進入。若跳過 Mantid Hatchlings 教學任務，進入星岬寺時就會學會那些技能。
entries.reason: 保留跳過教學時仍會補授技能的條件；不把進入寺院誤成需要手動載入的操作。

entries.source: You will also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Sword after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Zhan, who is nearby, for your reward.
entries.text: 進入寺院後，還會獲得 2,000 經驗值與一把 Starter Sword；若已完成教學，這些獎勵早已領取。與附近的 Headmaster Zhan 交談，領取任務獎勵。
entries.reason: 區分進入時補發獎勵與交談領獎，避免暗示完成教學者能重複取得；保留 2,000 經驗值。

entries.source: Escort Kormir, Koss and 3 Sunspear Recruits to First Spear Jahdugar just outside Chahbek Village. Along the way, 2 Corsairs will popup, however they are easily defeated.
entries.text: 護送 Kormir、寇斯與 3 名日戟新兵，前往 Chahbek Village 外的 First Spear Jahdugar 處。途中會突然出現 2 名海盜，但不難擊敗。
entries.reason: 保留護送人數、目的地與兩名伏兵；修正 popup 的介面彈出誤譯，Sunspear 用詞統一為日戟。

entries.source: Go through the Lakeside County gate to the northwest and leave Ascalon City. Your profession trainer will be standing directly outside. Speak to them to complete the quest.
entries.text: 從阿斯卡隆城西北方通往湖畔郡的大門離城。職業導師就站在門外；與導師交談，即可完成任務。
entries.reason: 保留西北方出口及導師就在門外的位置；profession trainer 是職業導師，並非專業培訓師。

entries.source: Destroy the corsairs occupying the village.
entries.text: 消滅佔領村莊的海盜。
entries.reason: 核對攻擊對象是佔領村莊的海盜，現有譯文符合目標。

entries.source: Sink the corsair ship on the north side of the village.
entries.text: 擊沉村莊北側的海盜船。
entries.reason: 核對船隻位於村莊北側；未與南側船隻目標互換。

entries.source: Sink the corsair ship on the south side of the village.
entries.text: 擊沉村莊南側的海盜船。
entries.reason: 核對船隻位於村莊南側；未與北側船隻目標互換。

entries.source: *BONUS* Keep as many Sunspear Recruits alive as possible.
entries.text: *額外獎勵* 讓盡可能多的日戟新兵存活。
entries.reason: Bonus 是額外獎勵目標；統一 Sunspear 為日戟，保留以存活人數衡量的要求。

entries.source: Eliminate all of the corsairs attacking the village, including those on the boats on the right and left sides of the map. You are aided in your efforts by the presence of a level 20 Kormir and a handful of Sunspear recruits.
entries.text: 消滅所有攻擊村莊的海盜，包括地圖左右兩側船上的海盜。等級 20 的 Kormir 與幾名日戟新兵會協助作戰。
entries.reason: 保留必須清除船上海盜的範圍；Kormir 的等級 20 不改寫成隊伍人數。

entries.source: After killing the corsairs near the village's entrance, you have a choice: follow Kormir's advice and sink the two vessels using Istani Fire Oil fired from the catapults or kill the ship-based corsairs using ranged attacks. If you choose the first method, make your way to the fire oil and carry it to one of the catapults: click once to load the weapon and click again to fire it. Each ship you sink will provide a morale boost. Kill the boss next and then clear out the remainder of the corsairs.
entries.text: 擊殺村莊入口附近的海盜後，可選擇依 Kormir 的建議，用投石器發射 Istani Fire Oil，擊沉兩艘船；也可使用遠程攻擊擊殺船上海盜。若採第一種方法，先拾取火油，帶到任一座投石器旁；點擊一次裝填，再點擊一次發射。每擊沉一艘船都會獲得士氣提升。接著擊殺 Boss，再清除其餘海盜。
entries.reason: 校正遠程攻擊、投石器裝填與發射兩次操作；保留兩種可選方法，boss 不再誤作老闆。

entries.source: You can speed things up by flagging koss and any henchmen to kill corsairs while you sink the ships.
entries.text: 可用旗幟命令寇斯與傭兵擊殺海盜，同時由你擊沉船隻，以加快進度。
entries.reason: Flagging 指用隊伍旗幟下達移動指令，並非標記角色；明確分工為隊友清敵、玩家沉船。

entries.source: The recruits sometimes are slow to engage mobs. If this happens, step closer to the enemy so that foes are within aggro range of the sunspears.
entries.text: 新兵有時不會立即與敵群交戰。遇到這種情況，向敵人靠近，讓敵人進入日戟新兵的警戒範圍。
entries.reason: Mobs 指敵群，並非暴徒；保留移動玩家使新兵進入交戰距離的操作。

entries.source: Keep as many of the Sunspear recruits alive as possible. If you confront one group at a time, there is almost no risk to losing any to the corsairs, especially if you sink the ships early.
entries.text: 讓盡可能多的日戟新兵存活。一次只對付一群敵人時，新兵幾乎不會被海盜殺死，尤其是及早擊沉船隻的情況下。
entries.reason: 修正死亡對象反轉：原文 losing any 指損失新兵，並非不會失去海盜；保留逐群交戰與及早沉船的前提。

entries.source: Bring condition removal skills, since nearly all foes inflict some condition.
entries.text: 攜帶移除病症的技能，因為幾乎所有敵人都會施加病症。
entries.reason: Condition 在遊戲中是病症，並非一般條件；保留因敵人施加病症而建議帶解除技能的因果。

entries.source: In normal mode, non-boss foes do not use any skills. In hard mode, all foes only use one skill, so you can easily disable them. This makes Wastrel's Demise and Worry effective in both modes.
entries.text: 普通模式下，非 Boss 敵人不會使用技能。困難模式下，每名敵人都只會使用一種技能，因此容易封鎖其技能。這使「瓦斯崔之死」與「瓦思崔的憂慮」在兩種模式中都很有效。
entries.reason: Only one skill 是每名敵人各一種，並非所有敵人共用同一技能；Worry 是 Wastrel's Worry 的省略，依固定詞典補全中文名。

entries.source: None of the foes carry hex spells or hex removal skills.
entries.text: 敵人均未攜帶降咒魔法或移除降咒的技能。
entries.reason: Hex spells 與 hex removal 分別是降咒與移除降咒；統一遊戲術語，保留兩類技能皆不存在的意思。

entries.source: Locate the laboratory of Oola, the Asuran master golemancer.
entries.text: 尋找阿蘇拉魔像大師 Oola 的實驗室。
entries.reason: Master golemancer 是人物專長，並非魔像本身；Oola 無固定單獨中文身份詞條，保留英文姓名。

entries.source: Find Oola's former assistant, Blimm, in Rata Sum.
entries.text: 在洛達頂點尋找 Oola 的前助手布林姆。
entries.reason: 保留 former assistant 的過去身份；Blimm 有固定中文名稱，Oola 保留英文。

entries.source: Travel with Blimm to the secret entrance to Oola's Lab in Magus Stones.
entries.text: 與布林姆同行，前往 Magus Stones 中 Oola 實驗室的秘密入口。
entries.reason: 保留實驗室秘密入口位於 Magus Stones 的關係；不把地名無證據直譯為魔法石。

entries.source: Defeat the timberland guardian and pick a vine seed from its remains to open the bridge to Oola's Lab.
entries.text: 擊敗 Timberland Guardian，從其遺骸中拾取一顆藤蔓種子，以開通前往 Oola 實驗室的橋梁。
entries.reason: Pick from remains 指從遺骸取得掉落物，並非採摘活株；藤蔓種子有中文詞典支持，敵人姓名保留英文。

entries.source: Speak to Blimm about the secret entrance to Oola's Lab.
entries.text: 與布林姆交談，詢問 Oola 實驗室的秘密入口。
entries.reason: 保留交談目的為詢問入口資訊；不是已進入實驗室後的對話。

entries.source: Start off by talking to Blimm in Rata Sum to update the quest. Meet him in Magus Stones (right outside Rata Sum) with the party you will need for The Elusive Golemancer (follows on). Fight your way through Magus Stones taking care about patrols of Wind Riders. Wind Riders move quickly and aggroing several mobs at once can easily result in healers being overwhelmed. The actual Timberland Guardian is very weak since it's on its own.
entries.text: 先與洛達頂點的布林姆交談，更新任務。帶好接下來進行「烏拉的實驗室」所需的隊伍，在洛達頂點外的 Magus Stones 與他會合。一路戰鬥穿過 Magus Stones，留意馭風者巡邏隊。馭風者移動很快；同時引到多群敵人，很容易讓治療者不堪負荷。Timberland Guardian 本身很弱，因為牠獨自一隻。
entries.reason: 修正照顧巡邏隊與獨立等誤譯；保留先組好後續任務隊伍、快速巡邏與單獨目標較弱的原因。

entries.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Talon Silverwing.
entries.text: 在桑泉谷尋找 Talon Silverwing。
entries.reason: Sunqua Vale 有中文證據；人物全名缺固定中文身份證據，保留英文，避免不一致音譯。

entries.source: Talon is in the northwest of the vale.
entries.text: Talon 位於山谷的西北方。
entries.reason: 保留西北方向；Talon 是同一 NPC 的簡稱，不採無固定證據的泰隆音譯。

entries.source: Go southwest along the road to find the skale. Clear the river of skale.
entries.text: 沿路向西南尋找鱗怪，清除河道中的鱗怪。
entries.reason: Skale 指鱗怪，並非名為斯卡萊的河流；保留西南行進及清除河道敵人的兩步。

entries.source: Return to Van the Warrior for your reward.
entries.text: 返回戰士凡處領取獎勵。
entries.reason: Return 是返回領獎，不是影返；Van the Warrior 的中文身份有固定詞典支持。

entries.source: Follow your compass marker and kill the three skale in the area. Then return back to Van the Warrior.
entries.text: 沿指南針標記前進，擊殺該區域的三隻鱗怪，再返回戰士凡處。
entries.reason: 修正 skale 誤譯骷髏，依固定中文詞典採鱗怪；保留三隻敵人及返程步驟。

entries.source: Seek Renk in Riven Earth and recruit him for the project.
entries.text: 在撕裂大地尋找 Renk，招募他參與計畫。
entries.reason: 保留地點與招募條件；Renk 無固定中文身份證據，保留英文。
